relevant_files.role: LanguageInfo struct definition and get_language_info() function
Template for ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and extract_inheritance pattern

conventions.commits: Conventional commits with SPDX-FileCopyrightText headers; DCO not explicitly required in CONTRIBUTING but copyright headers mandatory
conventions.testing: Unit tests in language modules test queries (parse_and_query pattern), integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/integration_tests.rs verify language registration and element extraction
conventions.linting: cargo clippy -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --check, cargo deny check advisories licenses; workspace lints deny undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (with test-code exemptions)
conventions.error_handling: thiserror for error types, Option/Result for fallible operations, bounds checks on node.end_byte() before indexing source

patterns: Each language module exports ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, and optional REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY as &str constants
ELEMENT_QUERY captures function/method/class/interface/enum declarations with @function or @class tags
extract_inheritance() walks parent nodes or inspects field nodes (superclass, interfaces, base_clause, class_interface_clause) to extract base class and interface names
extract_function_name() uses node.child_by_field_name("name") to extract identifier text
find_receiver_type() walks ancestors to find enclosing class/interface/enum
DEFUSE_QUERY uses @write.local, @write.assign, @writeread.update, @read.usage tags to mark definition/use sites

Language registration requires: (1) mod declaration in mod.rs, (2) match arm in get_language_info(), (3) match arm in get_ts_language(), (4) extension entry in lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP, (5) entry in supported_languages() slice

related_issues.title: Add PHP language support via tree-sitter-php
related_issues.relevance: Primary task: integrate tree-sitter-php grammar to enable PHP code analysis

constraints: tree-sitter-php grammar uses function_definition (not method_declaration) for top-level functions; method_declaration for class methods
PHP class inheritance uses base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) as child nodes, not field nodes like Java
PHP enum_declaration has name, body, and optional class_interface_clause fields
DEFUSE_QUERY must be provided because PHP supports local variable declarations, assignments, and identifier reads that need semantic tracking
All languages are unconditionally compiled in; no feature gates for PHP
HTML support is a stub (tree-sitter-html incompatibility); PHP should not follow that pattern
test_coverage: Existing language modules have 5-10 unit tests covering: (1) element query extraction (functions, classes, interfaces, enums), (2) call query extraction, (3) import extraction, (4) inheritance extraction (extends/implements), (5) defuse query write/read sites, (6) edge cases (empty files, decorated definitions). Integration tests verify language registration and round-trip analysis. PHP tests should cover all 6 dimensions plus PHP-specific features: trait declarations, anonymous classes, closures, and mixed type hints.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; grammar node types: function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, enum_declaration, trait_declaration, anonymous_class, arrow_function, closure; field names: name, body, base_clause, class_interface_clause, trait_use_clause
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar distinguishes function_definition (top-level) from method_declaration (class/trait/interface members). Inheritance uses child nodes (base_clause for extends, class_interface_clause for implements) rather than field nodes. Supports modern PHP features: enums with backing types, attributes, union/intersection types, match expressions, named arguments.

library_findings.relevant_api: Parser, Query, QueryCursor, Language, Node; field access via child_by_field_name(), named_child(), kind(), start_byte(), end_byte()
library_findings.notes: Core parsing library used by all language modules. Query syntax uses @capture tags and field accessors. Node traversal via parent(), child(), named_child() for tree walking.

approaches.name: Minimal PHP integration (CSS-like pattern)
approaches.description: Create php.rs with only ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY, omitting optional queries (REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY). Register in mod.rs, lang.rs, and Cargo.toml. Add unit tests for element extraction. No inheritance or defuse support.
pros: Covers basic symbol extraction (functions, classes, methods)
Follows CSS precedent for minimal languages
cons: Incomplete feature set compared to Java/Python

approaches.name: Full PHP integration with inheritance and defuse (Recommended)
approaches.description: Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, extract_function_name(), find_receiver_type(), and extract_inheritance(). Handle PHP-specific nodes: function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, enum_declaration, trait_declaration, anonymous_class. Register in mod.rs, lang.rs, Cargo.toml. Add 9+ unit tests covering all dimensions. Extract inheritance from base_clause and class_interface_clause child nodes.
pros: Covers PHP-specific constructs (traits, anonymous classes, closures)
cons: More complex DEFUSE_QUERY for PHP variable scoping
Requires careful handling of PHP's mixed typing and union types

approaches.name: Phased PHP integration (Phase 1 minimal + Phase 2 full)
approaches.description: Implement Approach 1 first (minimal), merge, then add DEFUSE_QUERY, inheritance, and import support in a follow-up PR. Allows early value delivery while deferring semantic analysis.
pros: Allows community feedback before full implementation
cons: Requires two PRs and two review cycles
Temporary incomplete feature set in released versions
More total work (overhead of two PRs)

recommendation: Approach 2 (Full PHP integration with inheritance and defuse). The issue title explicitly requests PHP support, and the project's design philosophy emphasizes comprehensive symbol extraction and semantic analysis. Full feature parity with Java/Python ensures PHP users get the same comprehension capabilities as other languages. The additional implementation effort (4-6 hours vs 2 hours) is justified by: (1) consistency with existing language integrations, (2) enabling semantic analysis for PHP codebases, (3) reducing future maintenance burden (no follow-up PR needed), and (4) the project's commitment to 'precise structural context' for coding agents. DEFUSE_QUERY is required because PHP supports local variable declarations, assignments, and identifier reads that need semantic tracking for use-case completeness.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
(
  (function_definition
    name: (name) @func_name) @function
  (method_declaration
    name: (name) @method_name) @function
  (class_declaration
    name: (name) @class_name) @class
  (interface_declaration
    name: (name) @interface_name) @class
  (enum_declaration
    name: (name) @enum_name) @class
  (trait_declaration
    name: (name) @trait_name) @class
  (anonymous_class
    body: (declaration_list)) @class
)
inheritance_walk_citation: For a class_declaration node in tree-sitter-php grammar: (1) call node.child_by_field_name("name") to get the class name identifier, (2) iterate through node.named_child(i) to find base_clause child node (if present) and extract the name field to get extends class name, (3) iterate through node.named_child(i) to find class_interface_clause child node (if present) and iterate its named children to extract each interface name. Source: https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php/blob/master/php/src/node-types.json shows class_declaration fields are {attributes, body, name} with optional children {class_interface_clause, primitive_type}; https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php/blob/master/common/define-grammar.js shows base_clause and class_interface_clause are optional child nodes (not field nodes) in the class_declaration rule.
